There Is a Reason That the European Leaders Need a War to Control Their Own Population

"American Psychos"

Solari Report Money & Markets: June 4, 2026 with Catherine Austin Fitts & John Titus 

Full Report available at Solari.
audio_track_actual: Original audio — Catherine Austin Fitts (Solari Report 'Money & Markets,' June 4 2026, with John Titus); 35-second excerpt.
audio_content_summary: Short clip: notes Peter Thiel's reported move to Argentina ($12M mansion); asserts that rolling crypto and private-equity into 401(k)s amounts to a plan to 'steal everybody's 401k' and bury the risk in index funds; closes with the line that 'European leaders need a war to manage their own population.'
implied_frame: Frames an elite financial restructuring — capital flight at the top (Thiel exiting the US) paired with a 'crypto/private-equity rollup' that loots ordinary retirement savings — plus a closing population-control claim about Europe. Group A (documented): Thiel did buy a ~$12M Buenos Aires mansion and relocate his family (record 2026-thiel-argentina-relocation-001); and the Aug. 7, 2025 executive order does direct the Labor Department to open 401(k)s to crypto, private equity, and real estate (record 2025-401k-crypto-private-equity-001). Group B (contested): that the 401(k) change is designed to 'steal' retirement savings / dump 'crap' into index funds — an attributed motive over a real but slow rulemaking. Group C (no primary trace): that Thiel is fleeing an imminent 'security issue' / 'doesn't want to walk down the street in America' (motive-reading), and that 'European leaders need a war to manage their own population.' The two underlying facts are real; the theft-intent and the war-for-control framing are the creator's.
